page.overview:
Who is Cecil Harvey?

32px|Paladin menu portrait (SNES). 28px|Paladin portrait (GBA/Mobile). Paladin portrait (DS). 32px|Paladin portrait (PSP). 29px|Portrait in The After Years. 32px|Portrait from The After Years (PSP). 32px|Portrait from The After Years (Android/iOS/Steam).

Cecil Harvey is the main protagonist of Final Fantasy IV who is also playable in Final Fantasy IV -Interlude- and Final Fantasy IV: The After Years. Cecil is one of the few characters in the series to permanently change his job during the game, starting out as a Dark Knight, but after a trial and the battle with the first of the Four Elemental Archfiends, transforms into a Paladin.

In the English version of the 3D remake originally released for Nintendo DS, as well as in Dissidia Final Fantasy, Cecil is pronounced (seh-sil). However, the bonus disc included with the Final Fantasy XII collector's edition pronounces it as (see-sil).

Cecil wears dark armor that covers his body and face while he is a Dark Knight (the 3D render shows his eyes). When he becomes a Paladin, Cecil wears a blue and white armor that reveals his appearance: shoulder-length white hair, blue eyes, pale skin, and a tinge of purple on his lips. Even though Fusoya claims Cecil resembles his father, Kluya, in his youth, it is stated that Cecil greatly resembles his mother, Cecilia, even being named after her.
